android-adb-missing.title: adb_missing · android_tool_missing — adb not found
fix_short: If the SDK is elsewhere, call again with ANDROID_HOME=<SDK path> in front
launch_cli.py doctor

android-app-not-foreground.title: app launch is ok but another screen is on top
fix_short: Check blocking_activity in the response
Check directly with adb shell dumpsys window | grep mCurrentFocus

android-emulator-unresponsive-host-swap.title: Emulator does not respond — host memory is full
fix_short: Check memory pressure with launch_cli.py doctor --resources
Clean up and boot again with launch_cli.py device reboot --device <id> --cold

android-flutter-doubled-desc.title: Android Flutter button desc appears twice
fix_short: launch_cli.py app tap --desc <label> (newer versions match line by line)
On older versions, pass the whole string including the newline to --desc

android-korean-ime-jamo.title: Android app type is ok but the Korean keyboard turns input into jamo
fix_short: launch_cli.py app type --ime ascii --text <value> (switches to the Maestro IME while typing, then restores)
Manual: adb shell ime set dev.mobile.maestro/.input.MaestroInputMethodService, type, then restore the original IME

android-maestro-driver-start-timeout.title: maestro_driver_timeout — Maestro Android driver did not start in time
fix_short: app flow already force-stops the driver apps and retries once before returning this code. Do not repeat the same command right away
Check whether heavy work such as a build (gradle · xcodebuild) is running, and retry after it ends

android-maps-locale.title: Google Maps labels do not follow the app language
fix_short: launch_cli.py device locale --device <id> --lang ja --region JP --app <package>
Directly: adb shell cmd locale set-app-locales <pkg> --locales ja-JP (verify with get-app-locales)

android-no-focused-window.title: no_focused_window — no focused window, screen structure unreadable (null root)
fix_short: The CLI already wakes the screen (WAKEUP · unlock) and reads up to three times before returning this code. Call app tree once more after a few seconds
Look at the current screen with app shot. If it is a password lock screen, ask the user to unlock it

android-non-ascii-text.title: Android app type returns non_ascii_unsupported — adb cannot type Korean
fix_short: If an English or numeric value works instead, use it
If Korean text is required, ask the user before installing an IME such as ADBKeyboard

android-system-restart-loop.title: android_system_not_ready · ui_automation_unavailable — emulator restart loop
fix_short: adb -s <serial> shell getprop init.svc.bootanim — if running, the system is not up yet
After the user confirms, adb -s <serial> reboot (soft reboot, keeps data). Measured: boot finished in 52 s and app run worked

browser-start-stale-process-or-lock.title: web open fails with browser_start_failed — a problem left after self-recovery
fix_short: Read stderr_tail in the response — it holds the reason the browser died immediately
If profile_locked is true, find the browser process using the response's profile folder (ps · Task Manager), confirm with the user, then end it

desktop-window-listed-but-content-elsewh.title: A listed dialog shows almost no elements, or click returns ref_stale
fix_short: launch_cli.py desktop windows # list again; pick the window that holds the content (zero-size placeholders are no longer listed)
launch_cli.py desktop find --window "<that title>" --text "<button>"

general-app-no-device.title: app command returns no_device — several devices attached or simulator not booted
fix_short: Pick one from android · ios_booted in the response and call again with --device <serial or UDID>
Bind a role to pin it as $DEV in env.sh: launch_cli.py device bind --role <role> --serial <serial>

general-bad-args-option-names.title: bad_args — wrong option name (--full-page · --field · positional argument)
fix_short: Read the unrecognized arguments · invalid choice part of error first
launch_cli.py web --help

general-cred-field-missing.title: --cred returns cred_field_missing — without a field choice it types password
fix_short: For the username box: launch_cli.py web type --selector <box> --cred <name> --cred-field account
If the field really is missing, get the value from the user and fill it with cred set (do not write the value yourself)

general-cred-never-read-config.title: Never read credentials straight from the config file
fix_short: Use app type --cred <name> --cred-field <field> / web type --cred
Use cred references in app run steps too

general-env-not-set.title: --text-env returns env_not_set — pass the variable name, not the value
fix_short: Prefix it on the same command line: CODE=<value> launch_cli.py web type --selector <box> --text-env CODE
The command line stays in the session record — pass only values that may stay there this way, such as one-time codes

general-login-interstitial-policy.title: Login stops every time at trust-device · stay-signed-in · upsell screens
fix_short: launch_cli.py cred policy get --name <name>
launch_cli.py cred policy set --name <name> --key trust_device --value always

general-otp-no-resubmit.title: Do not resubmit the login form while waiting for a verification code
fix_short: Do not resubmit the form while waiting for the code
First check with web text that the OTP screen is showing

general-plugin-cache-version-drift.title: Scripts called from a different plugin cache version path each session
fix_short: At session start, rerun the 'Find the scripts' block in SKILL.md to get SCRIPTS — do not paste an old version path
Read the docs from the same version folder too (references/ above SCRIPTS)

general-render-failed-first-error.title: render run returns render_failed — start from first_error; usually services.dart
fix_short: Read first_error in the response first (or output_tail if absent)
On Undefined name · Couldn't find constructor 'MethodChannel', add import 'package:flutter/services.dart';

general-root-unknown-skill-folder.title: Captures and state pile up in the wrong place, e.g. ~/.projectops/launch/scripts
fix_short: Call the script by absolute path from the project folder and add --root <project path>
Or prefix PROJECT_ROOT=<project path> (used when called from a scripts or cache folder)

general-timeout-unit-seconds.title: --timeout given in milliseconds — the unit is seconds
fix_short: Give --timeout in seconds (default 10, max 300)
If it already hung, recover with web close, then web open

general-zsh-variable-command.title: In zsh a command stored in a variable is one word and fails with 'no such file'
fix_short: Call the fixed entry point directly: python3 ~/.projectops/bin/launch_cli.py doctor
To repeat it, wrap it in a function: launch() { python3 "$HOME/.projectops/bin/launch_cli.py" "$@"; }

ios-app-vanishes-after-launch.title: iOS app vanishes right after launch, and app shot captures the home screen
fix_short: Read crash_report and the exception line in the launch_cli.py app launch response
If absent, open the latest Runner-*.ips in ~/Library/Logs/DiagnosticReports

ios-label-in-desc-doubled.title: iOS Flutter button label appears doubled in desc, so --text cannot tap it
fix_short: Check the element's desc in app tree
Tap with launch_cli.py app tap --desc <text> (the latest version matches desc and doubled labels automatically)

ios-maestro-driver-port-conflict.title: iOS tree finds 0 elements with several simulators — driver port 22087 conflict
fix_short: Find the process holding the port with lsof -nP -iTCP:22087 -sTCP:LISTEN, and check which UDID's driver it is with ps -p <PID> -o command=
If another session's driver holds it, do not kill it — wait for that work to finish or ask the user (Maestro drives one simulator at a time)

ios-maestro-log-keeps-input-text.title: Maestro's record (maestro.log) keeps the real inputText value in plain text
fix_short: pro-launch's app type and type steps send the record to a temp folder (--debug-output <temp folder> --flatten-debug-output) and delete it; use the same options…
If records already remain, tell the user and ask whether to delete them (do not delete them on your own)

ios-maestro-not-installed.title: iOS app tap · swipe · tree return ios_tool_missing — Maestro is not installed
fix_short: Ask the user before installing: curl -fsSL "https://get.maestro.mobile.dev" | bash
launch_cli.py app tree --device <simulator id>

ios-maestro-point-integer-percent.title: Maestro flow point percentages accept integers only (NumberFormatException)
fix_short: Read the last error line in maestro.log first (~/.maestro/tests/<timestamp>/maestro.log)
Round the percentage to an integer (72.7% → 73%)

ios-maestro-session-reconnect.title: The resident session dropped — another maestro test attached to the same device
fix_short: One slow call is normal — keep going
If device_unreachable persists, check whether another session is running maestro on the same device (ps -ax | grep maestro)

ios-maestro-slow-cold-start.title: iOS app tap · swipe · tree take tens of seconds — Maestro JVM starts per call
fix_short: If you look → decide → tap many times, start the resident session first: launch_cli.py app session start --device <UDID> (then tree 0.6 s · tap 1 s)
Do not fire the same command again because it is slow — wait for the previous call to finish

ios-maestro-stale-driver-or-overload.title: iOS tap fails at 90 s and session start fails too — leftover driver or load
fix_short: Check load with uptime (2x the core count or more means overload)
In ps, check that maestro-driver-ios-config · maestro/lib are not owned by a pro-launch session

ios-status-bar-custom-time.title: iOS capture status bar time must match the notification time
fix_short: launch_cli.py app shot --clean-status --time 7:42
By hand: xcrun simctl status_bar <UDID> override --time 7:42, capture, then restore with status_bar clear

ssh-sshpass-missing.title: Password ssh returns sshpass_missing — use a key or the fallback path
fix_short: With a key: launch_cli.py ssh --cred <server> --key-path <key file> --command '<command>'
Ask the user before installing sshpass: brew install hudochenkov/sshpass/sshpass

ssh-windows-cmd-encoding.title: Output from a Windows cmd (CP949) host is garbled
fix_short: Newer versions decode UTF-8 > CP949 in that order (check stdout_encoding)
On older versions, prefix the command with 'chcp 65001 >nul &'

web-browser-gone.title: web commands fail with browser_gone — could not attach to the running browser
fix_short: launch_cli.py web open --url <url>
If open fails with browser_start_failed: kb show browser-start-stale-process-or-lock

web-browser-not-open-other-root.title: browser_not_open right after opening — called from another project's location
fix_short: launch_cli.py web text --root <project path>
Call open with the same --root too. Do not cd into the scripts folder; call the script by absolute path

web-click-wait-with-expect.title: Do not wait with sleep — use click's --expect-url · --expect-text
fix_short: launch_cli.py web click --ref <number> --expect-text <text on the next screen> --timeout 30
launch_cli.py web click --ref <number> --expect-url <part of the new URL>

web-find-nothing-found.title: web find returns nothing_found — by default it finds only clickable elements
fix_short: launch_cli.py web text --max-chars 3000
launch_cli.py web find --text <text exactly as seen in web text>

web-goto-failed.title: web open · goto navigation fails — check the URL, the server, the certificate
fix_short: For a local server, first check it is up: launch_cli.py http --url <url>
Certificate error (test servers only): launch_cli.py web close

web-iframe-login-fields.title: Cannot find login fields inside an iframe (App Store Connect, etc.)
fix_short: launch_cli.py web type --selector "iframe >> internal:control=enter-frame >> input#account_name_text_field" --cred <name> --cred-field account
launch_cli.py web click --selector "iframe >> internal:control=enter-frame >> #sign-in" --expect-text <text shown after login>

web-orphan-headless-chrome.title: Double-clicking an HTML file does not open Chrome — orphan headless Chrome
fix_short: Clean up orphans with launch_cli.py web close --stale (other people's live browsers are only reported)
By hand: in ps -axo pid,ppid,command | grep -- --headless, look for entries with PPID 1

web-page-changed-by-other-session.title: Another session moves the same tab and your input is lost
fix_short: launch_cli.py web tab new --name <name> --url <url>
Prefix every web command in this session with LAUNCH_TAB=<name>

web-playwright-or-browser-missing.title: playwright_missing · browser_missing — web setup is needed
fix_short: Ask the user before installing (about 100 MB): launch_cli.py web setup
On an internal network, use an installed Chrome · Edge: prefix web open with LAUNCH_CHROMIUM_PATH=<browser executable path>

web-readonly-mutating-blocked.title: Save · submit buttons return mutating_blocked in a read-only session
fix_short: Tell the user what will change and get approval (hard to undo)
After approval: launch_cli.py web click --ref <number> --confirm-mutating

web-save-by-network.title: Judge whether a save worked by the request response, not on-screen text
fix_short: Check the POST/PUT response status with launch_cli.py web click --capture-requests
Judge by status 2xx vs 4xx (URL query strings are masked)

web-script-browser-memory-exceeded.title: Bulk scraping in web script bloats browser memory — use cookies + HTTP
fix_short: Use the browser only to log in, and have web script write context.cookies() to a file in the run folder (do not print it as the result — it would stay in the r…
Scrape over HTTP (urllib · requests) with those cookies in a Cookie header. If a list API exists, call the API instead of the screens

web-scroll-container-capture.title: Inner-scroll screens (Google Forms editor, etc.) are not captured by full-page
fix_short: launch_cli.py web shot --container <selector> --tiles 5
By hand: repeat web scroll --container <selector>, then web shot

web-secret-in-input.title: A secret value exists only inside an input or behind a copy button
fix_short: launch_cli.py web value --selector <selector> --save-env NAME (saves without printing the value)
For a copy button, click it, then web clipboard --save-env NAME

web-selector-guess-timeout.title: A guessed --selector misses — pick from candidates in the result, press by --ref
fix_short: Pick the right one from candidates in the failure result and call again with --ref as next says (earlier entries are closer to the guessed selector)
launch_cli.py web click --ref <number> --expect-url <part of the new URL>

web-viewport-width-height.title: web viewport --width --height returns bad_viewport — set the size with --preset
fix_short: launch_cli.py web viewport --preset 1280x900
launch_cli.py web viewport --preset mobile
